name: RxNorm
tagline: NLM drug nomenclature API for names, ingredients, and relationships
description: RxNorm is the U.S. National Library of Medicine API for normalized drug names, ingredients, and related clinical drug concepts used in healthcare systems.

auth.details: No authentication required for public REST endpoints; free public use under NLM terms.

use_cases: resolve a drug brand name to an RxCUI
list ingredients for a clinical drug
find related drug concepts by relationship type
search RxNorm for approximate name matches
get NDCs associated with an RxCUI
